name: Ekaterina Alexandrova
hometown: Prague, Czech Republic (born in Chelyabinsk, Russia)
intro: Ekaterina Alexandrova was born in Russia. She grew up in Prague. Her favorite shot is her forehand. Her favorite courts are hard courts, like the ones in New York. Last fall she reached the world's top 10 for the first time.
story: Ekaterina moved to Prague with her family at about age 12. The city had lots of tennis courts, so they stayed. She kept working for years and years. At age 30 she finally became a top 10 player. She was the No. 18 seed here. A seed is a ranking badge for top players. She won two matches in New York this year. What a run!

funFacts.text: She loves to cook. Her specialty is baking cakes.
She speaks three languages: Russian, Czech, and English.
She has a sister named Anna and a brother named Jury.
Her family moved to Prague after a kids' tournament there. They liked all the tennis courts!
Her dad Evgeny was her coach for many years. Her childhood hero was Steffi Graf.
Her favorite shot is the forehand. She started tennis at age six.
This year she won a doubles title in Abu Dhabi with Maya Joint.

watchFor: Watch her forehand, her favorite shot, and see how much she loves hitting it.
